name: Medical University of South Carolina Program

gap_details.2011-2012: PARTLY OBSERVED, partly reconstructed. Phase 2: NeuroNews (Dept of Neurosciences newsletter) Sept 2011 'Meet Our New Residents - Neurosurgery' observes the three 2011 joiners (Cheng PGY-1, Vargas Machaj PGY-1, Buchholz PGY-2, the last per his CV an MUSC gen-surg intern 2010-11). PGY-3..7 (Taylon, Lena, Kosnik, Krishna, Morgan) stay reconstructed from both-side evidence (Nov 2010/Feb 2011/June 2011 NeuroNews resident news + 2012-13 roster + alumni graduation years). The classes of 2005-2009 were 1/yr ('One resident is accepted each year', 2010 index page) and each has exactly one alumni graduate 2012-2016, so no senior could have left unseen. The one hidden person found: Yana Mikhaylov (2010 Match intern, NeuroNews May 2010; resident news Nov 2010-June 2011; absent 2012-13) -> MUSC general surgery (PGY-2 2014-15). Whether she was PGY-2 in 2011-12 is unknown; she is recorded as a departure either way (2010-11 'other' entry + training_history).
